CustomField.description: The Campaign this result counts, on a result broken down by campaign. Each campaign that sends a form is one round of it, so the same question can be compared from round to round. Blank on the overall result of a question, and on the result that counts the answers that carry no campaign.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Campaign whose answers this result counts. Blank on an overall result and on the result for answers with no campaign.
CustomField.label: Campaign
